authority: R3 ruling 2026-07-28 — C_inject prompt-leak scan must cover the same question set the experiment runs (50 rows). v1 numbers over 40 questions are INCOMPARABLE to v2 numbers over 50.

incomparable_prior.reason: v1 used (type||'find')==='find'; slice(0,40), covering only 40 of the 50 benchmark rows. C_inject counts from v1 and v2 cannot be compared.
incomparable_prior.rule: Do not put v1 and v2 figures in the same table. Cite v1 numbers only as historical/incomparable when needed.

channel_split_authority: R2 ruling 2026-07-28 — C_inject and C_disk are DIFFERENT ON PURPOSE; never merge. Predicates unchanged; surface lists corrected for channel conflation in the original DOCTRINE key.

question_set.filter: all 50 rows in file order; no type filter
question_set.note: git hash-object / git rev-parse HEAD:path of the benchmark file at freeze time

DOCTRINE_C_INJECT.role: Tier -1 / Channel-C packet floor — what a subject actually receives
DOCTRINE_C_INJECT.resolution: CLAUDE.md + transitive @-includes resolved mechanically from file headers (not a hand-list that drifts). Current resolution at channel_split_at: @_SYSTEM/yuri-origin.md, @SOUL.md, @_SYSTEM/persona.md.
DOCTRINE_C_INJECT.exclude_reason: Other harnesses' adapters. On disk (C_disk), never injected into this experiment's packet.
DOCTRINE_C_INJECT.owner: C_inject fixture + scan at pinned commit

DOCTRINE_C_DISK.role: partition class DOCTRINE — doctrine on disk reachable by grep; outcome C_DISK_COPY
members_declared_out_of_repo: ~/.claude/CLAUDE.md (global) — declared in source-partition-v1 as 'CLAUDE.md (global + project)'; not scanned by the repo-rooted regenerator. Counts that omit it remain a lower bound if global adds literals.
DOCTRINE_C_DISK.owner: C_disk full-class literals + union/intersection with REGISTRY

DOCTRINE.defect: Mixed C_inject and C_disk: scanned two never-injected adapters (AGENTS.md, sync.mdc) while missing three always-injected transitive includes (SOUL.md, persona.md, yuri-origin.md). Produced the under-scoped 12-id list.

normalization.expect_path: for each String(expect[i]).replace(/^\.\//,'') — strip leading ./ only; no other path normalization
normalization.surface_bytes: readFileSync utf8 as stored on disk; no NFC/NFD normalize; no line-ending normalize

explicitly_disabled: symlink realpath rewriting of expect or surface
match_rules.context_policy: A hit counts regardless of surrounding context: comments, URLs, markdown code fences, JSON string values, and prose all count. No exclusion by AST or comment-stripping.
match_rules.aggregation: A question is a candidate if ANY enabled predicate hits on ANY present surface in the class for ANY of the question's declared expect paths. Evidence records every (expect, surface, predicate) hit with a ±40 char snippet around the first indexOf match (full_path preferred when both hit on the same surface).

must_embed: per-surface content sha256 at scan time
